state.misconception_label: Believes if you changed all values by the same proportion the range would not change

turn_history.text:
I have: Tom and Katie are discussing the \( 5 \) plants with these heights: \( 24 \mathrm{~cm}, 17 \mathrm{~cm}, 42 \mathrm{~cm}, 26 \mathrm{~cm}, 13 \mathrm{~cm} \) Tom says if all the plants were cut in half, the range wouldn't change. Katie says if all the plants grew by \( 3 \mathrm{~cm} \) each, the range wouldn't change. Who do you agree with? I got Only
Tom because I'm not sure I worked it out the right way.

turn_history.text: Let's first clarify the concept of range and how changing all values by the same proportion can affect it. Can you explain to me why you think Tom's statement is correct and how you approached working it out?

turn_history.text: Um, I thought that if you cut all the plants in half, like divide them all by 2, then the difference between the biggest and smallest would stay the same because you're doing the same thing to all of them? But now I'm not really sure... does it actually change the range or not?
